Hi Marissa —

Thanks — this is great. I started the intake on our side and attached our vendor intake form for reference (vastly_vendor_intake_form.pdf). I'm looping in our security engineer, Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@vastlyhealth.com).

Couple quick questions so we can prep the right artifacts:
- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report (within the last 12 months) and is it available under NDA?
- For SAML, can you provide SP metadata (or a metadata endpoint) and documentation on whether you support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows?
- For SCIM, we typically need group sync and deprovisioning examples.
- For RBAC, a short matrix of default roles + admin capabilities would be helpful.

We prefer Drive links for uploads. If you can put the evidence in a shared folder with restricted access, that works. We’ll also likely open a Jira ticket for the formal questionnaire to track internally.

Thanks — looking forward to the technical call.

Best,

Subject: Re: Post-demo: IAM evidence & vendor security questionnaire

Alice/Tom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I populated the intake where we could and uploaded an initial evidence bundle to the shared folder (link below). Items included as attachment stubs here and in the Drive: redwood_sso_config.xml, redwood_scim-overview.pdf, redwood_soc2-summary.pdf.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in June 2026. Full report is available under NDA; summary attached (redwood_soc2-summary.pdf).
- SAML: We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. SP metadata (XML) attached (redwood_sso_config.xml). We support standard attributes and can add custom mappings if needed.
- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 for user + group provisioning, including push deprovisioning. See the quick overview (redwood_scim-overview.pdf) — Dev can share the SCIM schema examples on the call.
- RBAC/Admin controls: We have default admin roles (Org Admin, Workspace Admin, Billing Admin) and support custom roles with scoped permissions. We also maintain an admin activity audit log that can be surfaced via the Console / audit export.

Where to upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-vastly-iamevidence (shared with alice.jenkins@vastlyhealth.com).
Doc/DPA: I’ve also included a DocuSign link for a mutual NDA/DPA if you prefer to sign before accessing the full SOC 2 report: https://www.docusign.com/link/dpa-redwood-vastly

Proposed 30m tech sync: Thursday 2026-07-03 10:00 AM PT — does that work for you both? Dev can cover SCIM mapping and SAML attribute mapping.

If you need a specific export (admin account list, last-login, or provisioning logs) note that we'll need a formal request via the Jira ticket — happy to provide sample exports.

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
